verdicts.note: Also mentions transmission jerking, but the coolant light and lack of heat lead and every model agreed.
Front axle seal leaking -- the same POWER TRAIN/SUSPENSION axle boundary the earlier adjudication accepted as ambiguous for 95038.
The seat is where it broke, but the failed part is the airbag occupancy sensor and the consequence is a disabled airbag.

Not a complaint narrative at all -- a telematics dump of three unrelated recall notices (powertrain control module software, driver seat buckle, door-hem paint sealant) with no failure described. Gold picked the first one listed. User confirmed deletion 2026-08-31.
Another tie-rod row, but here the complaint is explicitly about steering and handling and the dealer adjusted the steering column, so STEERING is clearly primary.
'Cooling fan relay failed causing battery to drain' -- the failed part is a relay (electrical) belonging to the cooling system. Both readings are supported.
